items.title: DR Congo and M23 rebels agree roadmap for peace talks
items.description: Representatives met in Switzerland to work out next steps to resolve the conflict.

items.title: DR Congo, AFC/M23 group agree on roadmap for peace negotiations after Swiss talks
items.description: Mediators representing the Rwanda-backed AFC/M23 armed group and the Democratic Republic of Congo in a joint statement published Sunday said they have agreed on a roadmap for peace talks. The two sides said they had "agreed on the importance of a standardised method for reporting allegations of ceasefire violations".

items.description: Iran warns that countries backing US economic sanctions will be considered an enemy of Tehran.

items.title: Ukraine: Zelenskyy rejects wartime elections
items.description: The Ukrainian president says wartime elections, as called for by the ex-defense minister, could "split Ukraine." He also said Russia was planning to mobilize hundreds of thousands of troops after September polls there.

items.title: Ukraine's Drone War Exposes An Uncomfortable Reliance On China
items.description: Ukraine's drone industry has boomed since Russia's invasion, but it still relies on critical Chinese components. A waiver of EU procurement rules underscores Kyiv's uncomfortable wartime dependence on Beijing.

items.title: The slow reconciliation of Polish and Ukrainian memories over World War II mass graves
items.description: In the former villages of Wola Ostrowiecka and Ostrowki in western Ukraine, archaeologists and historians have been exhuming the bodies of Polish civilians massacred by Ukrainian nationalists in 1943. More than 80 years later, this painful past still weighs on diplomatic relations between Kyiv and Warsaw.

items.title: Breaking the silence over sexual violence against men and boys in war
items.description: Conflicts can expose civilians and detainees to grave abuses; the challenge is not only to document these crimes, but also to ensure all survivors are recognised, protected and able to access justice and care.

items.title: Russian 'Double-Tap' Strike on Shopping Mall in Ukraine Kills 15 and Wounds 130
items.description: A shopping mall was struck in the daytime attack on President Volodymyr Zelensky's hometown.

items.title: Top Iran official says U.S. focus on economic warfare shows it has failed militarily
items.description: The Iranian regime has dismissed President Trump's threats to crush Iran economically, saying that years of U.S. sanctions have failed.
